chapter: Sonny South breakup and small bands
title: Playing with Kid Thomas; Elton Theodore ran the business and phone
summary: He played early on with Kid Thomas's band, whose business Elton ran, and compares that to his own booking role for Sonny South.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Was he any kind to Willie Kaifer? Did you ever know Willie Kaifer? I don't know Willie Kaifer. He was a musician? Yeah. He was a trumpet player and Henry Rush was telling me about him.
Yeah, well that's another guy. Yeah. And I worked with Henry Rush with Kit Thomas. Oh yeah? Yeah.
When were you working with Thomas? That was way early in your career? Yeah, it was kind of early in my career. You never worked in his band in later years?

No. You see, well, Kit Thomas and the guy they called Elton, well I didn't know this until afterwards. It was Kit Thomas' band, but Elton was running the band. You see, we all started with Elton's band until they had some kind of misunderstanding, and they split. So he had to change the name from Kit Thomas to another name, you see. So that's when I started playing with them. They always called him Kit Thomas.

Morgan told me he was in the band and they had real trouble, Andrew Morgan, said he had a lot of trouble with the telephone then. Because the phone was in Elton Paredo's house, is that right? Yeah, that's what I'm talking about.

See, in other words, Kit Thomas was the real owner of the band. But Elton used to run the band, you see, so all the business was transacted through Elton. Yeah. Well that's the same way it was with the Sonny South. You see, I wasn't managing nothing, but I wasn't working, I wasn't doing nothing, playing music, and other guys was working, and so I used to transact all the business, you know, get jobs like that, transfer to Leo or McNeil. I would contact them and have them go check the guy who's never called, you see. Who is McNeil now?
Uh, McNeil, he's a trumpet player, he was named at the Sonny South Symphony.
Well we can ask somebody. We'll ask him. You don't know his first name. Well, I forget his first name.
Alvin, Alvin, Alvin, Alvin, Alvin was McNeil.

Well anyway, back to what we were talking about the telephone. What Morgan told me was that the phone was under the name of Kid Thomas, and was in Elton Theodore's house. That's right. So now Thomas has the phone under the name of Thomas Valentine. Yeah, and it caused a real mix-up.
Yeah, you see, it was going in Kid Thomas at that time, and then when they changed it, they put it in Valentine's.
Yeah. Well nobody can phone up Kid Thomas now unless they know his right name. That's right.
Nobody knew him about Valentine. No. I didn't know that either, as long as I didn't know any more of my days. I didn't know his children saw Valentine until then.
